verdict.rationale: The skill is an interactive, session-bound design workflow. It is gated on human checkpoints ('Nothing else is produced until you choose a direction') and triggers only when a user asks for a logo in a session. Its self-audits and rendering of drafts are autonomous steps inside a session, not background automations. Nothing in the pack shows scheduling, triggers, or unattended background runs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
